title: camissonia scapoidea var. macrocarpa
intro: Camissonia scapoidea var. macrocarpa, commonly known as the large-fruited evening primrose, is a plant species in the willow-herb family, Onagraceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, sore throat, and inflammation, due to its health benefits which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Camissonia scapoidea var. macrocarpa include soothing irritated tissues, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes. However, more research is needed to confirm the exact bioactive constituents and their effects on human health.
